digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter / config ownership gate
propositions: Twelve below-seam ambient config reads in reconciler JIRA adapter files are flagged as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows because they read composed-config keys (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, etc.) directly from os.environ instead of through owned resolvers.

Eleven of twelve flagged reads must be routed through new owned resolvers in config.py/_config_sources.py (resolve_jira_endpoint, resolve_jira_settings, resolve_acli_timeout, resolve_comment_max_chars, resolve_jira_datacenter_settings) so that ambient reads move into the composition root and remain live-per-call.

One flagged read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in outbound_fields.py) is owned-in-place via a # read-via: marker as a literal os.environ.get() call because it is a debug-only subsystem switch not in the config schema.
The credential reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) are already owned and remain unchanged; only composed-config reads are in scope for cutover.
All 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed and check_config_ownership.py must pass with zero exceptions for the six affected files and exactly one # read-via: marker in outbound_fields.py.
